label: prop:bar-self-dual-confinement-band
title: The open interval $(1/\varphi^2,\,\varphi^2)$ is the maximal bar-self-dual confinement band
html:
Let \iota \colon \mathbb{R}_{>0} \to \mathbb{R}_{>0} denote the bar involution \iota(q) = q^{-1}. The open interval

  \mathcal{B}  :=  \bigl(1/\varphi^2,\,\varphi^2\bigr) \subset  \mathbb{R}_{>0}

is the maximal connected \iota-invariant open subinterval of \mathbb{R}_{>0} excluding the golden nodes \{1/\varphi^2,\,\varphi^2\} (skew-dual golden node). Equivalently, \mathcal{B} is the largest interval satisfying the deconfinement criterion q > 1/\varphi^2 (deconfinement threshold) and its bar conjugate q < \varphi^2 simultaneously.
heading: Proposition
